_llm_instructions: Fill out 'project_title' and 'date_prepared', and the 'value' property of each field, using the project context. Use 'label' to select the correct output language. Reference parameters.md for global project variables.

id.label: ID
id.guidance: Enter a unique requirement identifier from the requirements documentation.

requirement.label: Requirement
requirement.guidance: Enter the requirement description from the requirements documentation.

acceptance_criteria.label: Acceptance Criteria
acceptance_criteria.guidance: Enter the criteria for acceptance, stated so they can be judged as met or not met.

validation_method.label: Validation Method
validation_method.guidance: Describe the method of validating that the requirement meets the stakeholder's needs.

verification_method.label: Verification Method
verification_method.guidance: Optional. Record the verification method used to prove that the deliverable meets the requirement. Adding this column turns the form into a product verification, validation, and acceptance form.

status.label: Status
status.guidance: Document whether the requirement or deliverable was accepted or not.

sign_off.label: Sign-off
sign_off.guidance: Obtain the signature of the party accepting the product.

acceptance_date.label: Acceptance Date
acceptance_date.guidance: Enter the date the product was accepted. This dates the acceptance for the project record and for the requirements traceability matrix.

comments.label: Comments
comments.guidance: Add any comments relevant to the acceptance, such as conditions attached to the acceptance, or items deferred to a later acceptance.
